name: Website Ventures Offer Draft

defaults.deliveryPromise: Do not promise a fixed ultra-fast delivery time until customers 1–10 provide measured evidence.

rules: The builder creates a customer-facing draft, not legal terms, an invoice or a signed agreement.
Scope is pulled from the recorded intake; do not silently expand it to make the offer look fuller.
Domain/hosting and paid third-party costs remain explicit rather than hidden in the website price.
Real proof and customer-supplied facts remain the customer's real inputs; AI/demo claims are not turned into customer evidence.
Any later change request is handled through the Delivery Gate change-request log.
